c70c86521ba7b980.description: The Senior Director, Asset Management provides strategic leadership and oversight of an organization's asset portfolio to maximize value, performance, and long-term returns. The role is responsible for portfolio strategy, financial performance, risk management, stakeholder engagement, capital planning, and leading asset management teams. Key responsibilities often include: Developing and executing asset portfolio strategies. Monitoring financial and operational performance. Leading asset optimization, refinancing, acquisition, and disposition initiatives. Managing relationships with investors, lenders, operators, and key stakeholders. Overseeing risk management, compliance, and governance activities. Providing executive-level reporting and recommendations to senior leadership Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Real Estate, Economics, or a related field. Master's degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred. Typically 10–15+ years of experience in asset management, real estate, infrastructure, investments, or related sectors. Proven leadership experience managing teams and complex portfolios. Strong financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and investment evaluation skills. Experience with portfolio optimization, risk management, and stakeholder management. Excellent communication, negotiation, and strategic planning capabilities. Ability to present recommendations to executive leadership Competitive benefits package

c756c312677e69e1.description: About El Seif Engineering Contracting Company El Seif Engineering Contracting Company operates with core values of excellence, integrity, and innovation. With over fifty years of experience across diverse industries, including public infrastructure, military, and defense, the company focuses on delivering projects with precision and attention to detail. El Seif aims to pioneer the future of construction through sustainable and impactful solutions. Role Overview: Senior Site Engineer El Seif Engineering Contracting Company is seeking a Senior Site Engineer with over 10 years of experience for a full-time position. This role involves managing a section of a construction project, providing technical advice, and supervising work crews and subcontractors to ensure tasks are completed on time and within budget. Key Responsibilities Support the development of KSA national employees to achieve corporate objectives, Saudization targets, and knowledge dissemination. Provide input to Human Resources on succession planning, employee career growth, and organizational structure. Manage the team with high standards of respect, integrity, accountability, agility, quality, safety, and corporate governance. Ensure compliance with the Code of Ethics policy and company values, reinforcing a strong people culture and ethical business practices. Oversee the adoption and utilization of systems and ERP within the team. Supervise day-to-day responsibilities of the section team in accordance with project plans, company policies, procedures, and approved budget. Oversee related equipment operations at the site and manage effective utilization. Assist the Construction Manager in preparing variation orders resulting from design or shop drawing approvals or client instructions. Follow up with project consultants for approval on designs, shop drawings, and material submittals. Report to the Construction Manager on the operational and financial status of the project section. Monitor labor availability and calculate daily productivity to support project execution within budget and schedule. Follow up on delivery and close out of the project section according to contractual arrangements and financial objectives. Prepare and present weekly section summary reports to the Construction Manager. Assist the Construction Manager in implementing directions to achieve high client satisfaction and constructive relationships. Collaborate with suppliers and subcontractors to establish detailed project plans, identifying key milestones and deliverables. Ensure health and safety compliance, including site inspections. Oversee the implementation of approved shop drawings as per specifications and standards. Support the Construction Manager in preparing all Inspection Requests by Consultant’s engineers. Review approved drawings, specifications, and standards. Optimize team and resource productivity to meet targets on time and within budget. Ensure all tasks are carried out in accordance with approved project plans. Maintain full awareness of the company's QHSE plan implementation on site. Prepare daily site reports and complete all forms related to the assigned section. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in site engineering or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage construction project sections, supervise teams, and ensure project delivery. Strong understanding of construction processes, project planning, and budget management. Work Type This is a full-time position.

c70895b502824643.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز الطب المتقدم للتخصصات الدقيقة في الرياض عن فني صيدلة للانضمام إلى فريقه. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة مكونات الأدوية الكيميائية، والإشراف على مراحل الإنتاج، وتشغيل آلات التصنيع، وإعداد التقارير الفنية. وهو مناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في المجال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مواصفات وتركيبات الأدوية والعقاقير والأمصال والسموم والمواد الصيدلانية، وتنفيذ خطة تصنيع الأدوية. تحديد الكميات المعيارية المعتمدة وإعداد البرنامج التنفيذي لإنتاج الأدوية بالتنسيق مع الصيدلي المشرف. تحضير المواد اللازمة لإنتاج الأدوية الصلبة والسائلة بحسب الكميات المطلوبة. تفقد وتشغيل وصيانة الأجهزة والأدوات المستخدمة في إنتاج الأدوية. متابعة إنتاج الأدوية والمستحضرات، وأخذ عينات من الدواء المنتج لتحويلها إلى المختبر ومطابقة المواصفات. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد لمكونات الأدوية الكيميائية وعمليات الإنتاج الصيدلاني. المهارات المطلوبة القدرة على تشغيل وصيانة آلات خلط وتجهيز وتصنيع الدواء. مهارات جيدة في إعداد وتقديم التقارير الفنية. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة في بيئة العمل الصيدلانية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الصيدلة في مركز الطب المتقدم للتخصصات الدقيقة بالرياض، ضمن بيئة عمل احترافية تركز على الدقة والجودة في تصنيع الأدوية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

c75f3236a665da2f.description: About Satel Satel invests in and operates residential communities across Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The company focuses on managing existing residential assets to create living environments for residents of diverse backgrounds, rather than on property development. The Role of Content Creator Satel is seeking a Content Creator to serve as the company's voice across various digital platforms. This full-time role involves capturing and presenting the lifestyle within Satel's residential communities, focusing on moments that convey a sense of belonging and community. The Content Creator will be responsible for the entire content creation process, from ideation to publication. Key Responsibilities Identify and develop compelling narratives that reflect Satel's brand and community life. Manage the end-to-end content creation process, including conceptualization, shooting, editing, captioning, and publishing across platforms. Appear in front of the camera when content requires a personal presence. Document community events, daily routines, and resident interactions with discretion. Monitor current trends on social media platforms and determine Satel's participation strategy. Analyze content performance based on reach, engagement, and inquiries generated, and adjust strategies accordingly. Reporting Structure and Work Environment The Content Creator reports directly to the Social Media Manager, who oversees strategy and the content calendar. This role is responsible for content creation and publishing within that framework. Collaboration with the in-house photographer, who handles property and unit visuals, is expected. The nature of community events requires availability during evenings and weekends, with work hours balanced throughout the week. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in content creation. Demonstrated ability to produce engaging content that highlights lifestyle and community. Proficiency in content production, including filming, editing, and publishing. Understanding of social media trends and platform dynamics. Ability to work independently and manage the full content lifecycle. Application Process Interested candidates should apply through LinkedIn. Please include a link to your portfolio and a one-sentence statement detailing the first change you would implement in Satel's social media presence.

c76428593beb50d8.description: About the Role Egis is seeking an experienced Risk & Planning Manager to join our consulting firm in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves identifying, analyzing, and mitigating organizational risks across diverse client engagements. The manager will collaborate with senior consultants and clients to develop comprehensive risk management strategies that align with business objectives and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Conduct comprehensive risk assessments and analyses for client organizations across various areas. Develop and implement risk mitigation strategies and action plans tailored to client needs and organizational objectives. Identify, document, and prioritize risks using established risk management frameworks and methodologies. Analyze risk data and trends to provide actionable insights and recommendations to clients and internal teams. Prepare detailed risk reports, dashboards, and presentations for executive stakeholders and board-level audiences. Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards related to risk management. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate risk management into business processes and decision-making. Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of implemented risk mitigation measures. Stay current with emerging risks, regulatory changes, and best practices in risk management. Support the development of business continuity and disaster recovery plans for clients. Mentor junior consultants and contribute to the development of risk management methodologies and tools. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong analytical capabilities, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex risk concepts to stakeholders at all levels. This role requires a professional with a proven track record in risk management within a consulting environment. Required Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in risk management. Work Location This position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time opportunity.

c7afac18e3cb18d8.description: About Chalhoub Group Chalhoub Group is a leading partner for luxury across the Middle East, operating over 600 stores and representing 300 brands with more than 65 years of experience. The group is evolving from a traditional distributor and retailer to a hybrid retailer, focusing on delivering luxury experiences to customers. The Role: Store Manager Chanel Beauty Chalhoub Group is seeking a Store Manager for Chanel Beauty in Makkah or Jeddah. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and involves driving store business, building a loyal VIP customer base, managing the store team, and ensuring adherence to brand guidelines and store processes. The Store Manager acts as a brand representative, communicating its values and philosophy through all interactions. Key Responsibilities Define, execute, and monitor the store action plan to achieve sales targets and KPIs. Manage the customer database to build strong relationships and identify future selling opportunities. Stay informed on industry trends, products, and competitors, sharing feedback with relevant back-office stakeholders. Leverage both online and offline points of sale to drive business. Ensure all sales and operational policies and procedures are followed and maintained. Oversee the preparation and processing of e-commerce orders within set SLAs for time and quality. Utilize available technology tools (Clienteling app, OMS, Business Whatsapp) to support customer experience and ensure team proficiency. Ensure operating standards are followed, from stock replenishment to visual merchandising according to brand guidelines. Ensure compliance with legal, safety, security, retail operations, and HR guidelines, escalating issues as needed. Analyze historical traffic data to anticipate peak hours and ensure healthy floor coverage. Team Leadership and Customer Experience Provide a clear vision to the team regarding business and store objectives. Identify, recruit, develop, and retain strong talent within the team. Foster a positive work environment based on trust, respect, and fairness, and communicate employee feedback to leadership and HR. Coach team members, promoting a growth mindset through available learning tools and monitoring development plans. Ensure performance improvement plans are discussed and documented transparently. Develop an omnichannel mindset among the team, promoting physical and digital customer touchpoints and clienteling techniques, especially for VIPs. Recruit new clients and convert them into loyal VIP customers through excellent service and networking. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience. Ability to lead by example and represent the brand's values. Proficiency in managing customer relationships and driving sales targets. Experience in team leadership, development, and performance management. Understanding of omnichannel customer experience and operational excellence. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah or Jeddah. The role offers opportunities for professional growth through enriching experiences, learning and development, and exposure to different assignments within the role or through internal mobility.

c728ec0e5fae1c46.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking an Accounting Supervisor AP/AR to join its team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time role involves overseeing the accurate maintenance of all receivables from various sources, including guests, tenants, concessionaires, credit card companies, online transactions, and employees. The Accounting Supervisor contributes to financial accuracy and operational efficiency within the hotel team. Key Responsibilities Safeguard signed cheques in the Financial Controller's safe and maintain a detailed log. Verify invoice backups for accuracy before distribution. Maintain an organized and up-to-date filing system. Respond to all inquiries promptly and professionally. Perform ad hoc tasks to ensure smooth hotel operations. Maintain accurate records of all receivables. Ensure all charges and account statements are correct and submitted on time for guests, groups, banquets, employees, and credit card companies. Required Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 3-4 years of relevant experience. Hilton values specific core qualities in its team members, which include: Hospitality: A commitment to delivering memorable experiences. Integrity: Acting with honesty and doing the right thing. Leadership: Inspiring others. Teamwork: Believing that collaborative efforts drive optimal outcomes. Ownership: A sense of accountability for responsibilities. Now: Bringing urgency and discipline to daily tasks. Work Type This is a full-time position within the Hotels team. Application Process Salary details for this position are not disclosed.

c76f9585a57b40ab.description: About BD and the Peripheral Intervention Business Unit BD is a global medical technology company focused on advancing health. The Peripheral Intervention (PI) business unit provides a comprehensive range of medical products, devices, and services for the treatment of peripheral arterial and venous disease, cancer detection, and end-stage renal disease and maintenance. The Role of Country Business Leader PI BD is seeking a Country Business Leader for Peripheral Intervention (PI) in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves developing and implementing business strategies to ensure continued growth of the PI Business, sales, and profitability in line with overall business strategy and Sales/GP targets. The Leader will manage sales and marketing operations to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales, GP, and OIBT goals, successfully implement the agreed Go-To-Market (GTM) model, and promote PI products and services while strengthening team capabilities and expanding geographical coverage. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Lead the development and execution of business and marketing plans, pricing strategies, commercial policies, and promotional initiatives across all PI platforms in Saudi Arabia to achieve or exceed sales, GP, and OIBT targets. Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing team by fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, talent development, and continuous improvement. Establish and strengthen partnerships with key decision-makers, influencers, and opinion leaders across the healthcare ecosystem. Manage demand planning, inventory forecasting, annual budgeting, and ongoing financial forecasts to ensure accurate sales and profitability. Build and maintain strategic relationships with government entities, the Ministry of Health, key opinion leaders, and healthcare decision-makers to influence healthcare policies, funding priorities, and regulatory frameworks. Identify and pursue new growth opportunities within the PI portfolio by leveraging market intelligence, emerging trends, and evolving customer needs. Lead market research, business analytics, and performance assessments to drive informed strategic decision-making and optimize platform performance. Monitor market dynamics, competitor activities, and industry trends, developing effective counterstrategies to protect and expand market share. Develop and articulate customer-centric value propositions tailored to target market segments. Drive the successful launch of new products and line extensions through comprehensive commercialization and adoption strategies. Ensure timely registration and regulatory compliance of the PI portfolio to support business continuity and growth objectives. Represent BD at industry conferences, scientific congresses, customer events, and professional forums as required. Manage promotional investments and expenses within approved budgets while maximizing return on investment. Foster a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, and teamwork across functions, businesses, and regional teams. Uphold BD’s standards of ethics, integrity, compliance, and professional conduct in all business activities, championing FCPA, Global Trade, and corporate compliance requirements. Lead the development and execution of national framework agreements to support sustained business growth and market access. Collaborate with META regional teams to define market segmentation, targeting, and growth strategies that accelerate penetration and expansion into new market segments. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will have 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field, demonstrating leadership capabilities in sales and marketing operations within the medical technology sector. A strong understanding of the healthcare ecosystem in Saudi Arabia, including government entities and regulatory frameworks, is essential. The role requires a professional committed to ethical conduct and compliance. Working at BD At BD, employees are encouraged to contribute to advancing healthcare. The company fosters a culture of learning, growth, and collaboration, emphasizing the value of in-person interaction for accelerated learning, deeper collaboration, and a stronger organizational culture.

c7b60c58ed15a998.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Safety Specialist to join their team in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, covering locations such as Umluj and Tabuk. This full-time role involves ensuring that site-specific Safety, Health, and Environmental (SH&E) plans, workplaces, and operational tasks align with Parsons' risk management practices and comply with all relevant regulatory and client SH&E requirements. Key Responsibilities Observe and record contractors' work practices to ensure adherence to safety protocols. Verify compliance with project-specific and legislative health and safety requirements. c7e4dd33b3877253.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الدعم الطبي للتجارة عن مدخل بيانات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل مسؤولية مراجعة استمارات البيانات وتدقيقها، بالإضافة إلى إدخال وتخزين المعلومات باستخدام الحاسب الآلي. يهدف الدور إلى ضمان دقة البيانات واكتمالها وسريتها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة الاستمارات المتعلقة بالبيانات وترميزها، والتأكد من اكتمال جميع المعلومات المطلوبة. إدخال البيانات والمعلومات بدقة في الحاسب الآلي، مع الالتزام بالبرامج والنظم الإحصائية المعتمدة. مراجعة رموز التصنيف للبيانات والمعلومات المدخلة، وتصحيح أي أخطاء قد تظهر. تخزين المعلومات المدخلة بشكل منظم وآمن. عمل النسخ الاحتياطية اللازمة للبيانات والمعلومات المخزنة لضمان عدم فقدانها. التقيد الصارم بالتعليمات والسياسات المتعلقة بسرية البيانات والمعلومات وحمايتها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدخال البيانات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على العمل بدقة واهتمام بالتفاصيل. إتقان استخدام الحاسب الآلي وبرامج إدخال البيانات. موقع العمل ونوعه هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. يتطلب الدور التواجد في مقر الشركة لضمان سير العمل بفعالية. عن شركة الدعم الطبي للتجارة تلتزم شركة الدعم الطبي للتجارة بتقديم خدماتها في مجال التجارة، وتسعى لتعزيز كفاءة عملياتها من خلال فريق عمل متخصص ومحترف. يتميز بيئة العمل بالتركيز على الدقة والالتزام بالمعايير المهنية. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة الدعم الطبي للتجارة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

c73413fab7c99877.description: نبحث عن باريستا شغوف وموهوب للانضمام إلى فريقنا المتميز، ولديه القدرة على إعداد قهوة استثنائية وتقديم تجربة مميزة لعملائنا. ستكون مسؤولاً عن تحضير مجموعة متنوعة من مشروبات القهوة، وضمان جودة المكونات، والحفاظ على بيئة عمل نظيفة ومنظمة. إذا كنت تمتلك مهارات تواصل ممتازة، وحباً للقهوة، ورغبة في التطور، فإن هذه الفرصة هي لك. * إعداد وتقديم أنواع مختلفة من مشروبات القهوة الإسبريسو والمشروبات الأخرى. * ضمان جودة المكونات الطازجة وتخزينها بشكل صحيح. * الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب منطقة العمل والمعدات. * تقديم خدمة عملاء ودودة وفعالة. * التعاون مع الفريق لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة.

c729592773668bc6.description: مطلوب سكرتير / مساعد إداري تعلن مؤسسة فيلفيت فايبز، المتخصصة في الورد والهدايا وتنسيق المناسبات، عن توفر وظيفة وفق التفاصيل التالية: • مقر العمل: المحل – الرياض، حي الورود. • ساعات العمل: من ٢ ظهرًا إلى ١٠ مساءً. • الراتب الشهري: ٤٬٠٠٠ ريال. المهام الوظيفية: • تحديث المنتجات في تطبيقات الطلب بالصور والأوصاف والأسعار والتوفر. • متابعة طلبات التطبيقات والتنسيق مع فريق المحل لتجهيزها وتسليمها. • دعم العمليات التشغيلية اليومية في المحل. • تنظيم بيانات العملاء وتحديثها وتجهيزها للحملات التسويقية. • الرد على استفسارات العملاء ومتابعة طلباتهم. • التنسيق مع الموظفين والموردين ومتابعة المهام. • تنظيم الملفات وإعداد التقارير اليومية. المتطلبات: • إجادة اللغتين العربية والإنجليزية تحدثًا وكتابةً. • الحصول على دورة في السكرتارية. • إجادة الحاسب وبرامج Microsoft Office، خصوصًا Excel. • مهارات التنظيم والمتابعة والتواصل مع العملاء. • الدقة في إدخال البيانات وكتابة أوصاف المنتجات. التقديم عبر منصة صبّار.

والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير معايير تجربة الضيوف والحفاظ عليها لتعزيز ولاء العملاء. الإجابة على استفسارات العملاء حول المنتجات والأسعار والتوافر والاستخدامات والخدمات. التواصل مع العملاء لتقييم احتياجاتهم وتقديم المساعدة في تلبيتها. إحاطة العملاء بنطاقات المنتجات الأنسب لاحتياجاتهم. توضيح استخدامات العلامات التجارية والمنتجات المختلفة ومزاياها. تعزيز المبيعات وتحقيق الأهداف المحددة للخطوط والمبيعات باستخدام المعرفة بالمكياج. متابعة الأهداف على مستوى المتاجر وإعداد تقارير المبيعات اليومية. المشاركة في تحقيق الحوافز ومتابعة أهداف البيع بعد إطلاق المنتجات الجديدة. التأكد من تحقيق مستويات التسويق في المتجر وفقًا لتوجيهات العلامة التجارية. التأكد من إعادة تموين المتاجر في الرفوف المناسبة وفي الأوقات المناسبة. رفع التقارير بنقص المخزون باستخدام نموذج طلب المخزون. التأكد من استلام المخزون وفقًا للإجراءات المحددة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تقديم خدمة عملاء مميزة. معرفة بأساليب المبيعات والمنتجات التجميلية. الالتزام بمعايير النظافة وإعادة التموين وإدارة عروض المنتجات. بيئة العمل والمزايا توفر مجموعة شلهوب فرصًا للتطور المهني من خلال التجارب المتنوعة وفرص التعلم. تُقدر المجموعة مساهمات الموظفين وتقدم حزمة مزايا تنافسية تشمل الرعاية الصحية، والمساهمة في تعليم الأطفال، وسياسات العمل عن بعد، وسياسات عمل مرنة، بالإضافة إلى خصومات حصرية للموظفين. تلتزم المجموعة بمبادئ الشمول والتنوع في جميع عملياتها، وترحب بجميع المرشحين المؤهلين للتقديم. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المرشحين المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم لهذه الفرصة. يتم دراسة جميع الطلبات بناءً على الاستحقاق وتكافؤ الفرص.

التسويات البنكية: شهرياً. تقرير الأرباح والخسائر لكل نشاط: شهرياً. تقرير التدفقات النقدية والالتزامات: شهرياً. التقرير المالي الشامل للإدارة والشركاء: نهاية كل شهر. ضوابط العمل والصلاحيات الفصل المحاسبي بين البوفيه والمتجر الإلكتروني. عدم إجراء أي صرف أو تحويل مالي دون اعتماد الجهة المخولة. توثيق جميع العمليات المالية بالمستندات اللازمة. المحافظة على سرية البيانات المالية والتجارية. رفع c731faf54a294b3c.description: Sanabil Studio is a venture builder that blends industry expertise, technology, and startup know-how to turn bold ideas into real businesses. We take concepts from zero to launch, and when a venture proves its potential, we back it with seed funding and hands-on support to help it scale. TradePay is one of those ventures building the trade finance infrastructure for FMCG in Saudi Arabia. Our mission is to replace informal supplier credit with structured, data-driven working capital that helps small merchants grow, protects suppliers from credit risk, and strengthens the FMCG supply chain. We are building a new credit system for underbanked merchants where risk is assessed through real transaction behavior and operational data across suppliers, distributors, and digital marketplaces. We are looking for a Head of Risk to build and lead TradePay's credit risk governance and portfolio risk management function reporting directly to the Founder. THE ROLE What you'll own here. Build and own TradePay's enterprise credit risk framework and governance model Define and manage risk appetite, portfolio thresholds, and escalation frameworks Develop and maintain credit, collections, fraud, and operational risk policies Oversee repayment behavior monitoring, delinquency management, and collections governance Establish provisioning, write-off, and portfolio monitoring frameworks Review and approve credit override and exception management processes Work with Data and Product teams to ensure underwriting models align with risk policies and operational controls Build governance processes around merchant onboarding, fraud escalation, dispute resolution, and collections Develop reporting frameworks for management, investors, and future regulatory readiness Prepare the business for future licensing and regulatory engagement in Saudi Arabia Support legal and compliance teams in ensuring operational and contractual alignment Lead future risk committee structures and build and mentor risk operations and collections team members How Success Will Be Measured Portfolio quality and delinquency rates, provisioning accuracy, governance and policy maturity, regulatory readiness, and the strength of risk frameworks as TradePay scales. Where This Role Can Go Head of Risk → Chief Risk Officer as TradePay scales and matures into a regulated entity. THE PROFILE You're probably a fit if… You have 8+ years of Saudi experience in credit risk, portfolio risk, collections, or enterprise risk management You've worked in banking, SME lending, fintech lending, microfinance, or regulated financial institutions You understand Saudi market dynamics and SAMA expectations You've designed and implemented credit policies and governance frameworks from the ground up You have a strong grasp of delinquency management, collections, provisioning, and portfolio controls You've worked with regulators or operated within regulated environments You're strong on stakeholder management and decision-making, and can operate in fast-moving startup environments while maintaining governance discipline You communicate clearly in writing and in the room Bonus: experience in B2B BNPL, supply chain finance, embedded finance, SME or merchant lending, Islamic finance and Sharia-compliant structures, or early-stage fintech environments THE ENVIRONMENT What working here actually looks like. Foundational Ownership You are building the risk foundations of a next-generation fintech platform from scratch. The frameworks you design today will define how TradePay scales tomorrow. Direct Impact on the Business Portfolio quality, scalability, and regulatory readiness all sit with you. Your decisions directly shape the long-term health of the business. A Role That Grows With You This position has a clear path into Chief Risk Officer as TradePay scales across Saudi Arabia and moves toward a regulated entity structure. What You Get From Us Competitive pay: A package that reflects your experience and the market, not a lowball with "equity upside" as the excuse. Meaningful equity: Real upside aligned with long-term value creation. Premium gear, day one: Everything you need to hit the ground running, set up and ready before your first morning. Mentorship that matters: Direct collaboration with the Founder and leadership team from people who've actually built and scaled ventures. An accelerated curve: You'll learn more here in 12 months than most roles offer in three years. Hiring Process Introductory recruiter conversation → Founder interview → Case study and framework discussion → Reference checks → Offer

المناسبة. تحويل خطوات العمل والمؤشرات والمقارنات والنتائج إلى رسوم وعناصر بصرية (إنفوجرافيك). تصميم الرسوم البيانية وبطاقات المؤشرات بالتنسيق مع محلل البيانات وأخصائي الأداء، مع الحفاظ على دقة التسليم، ومتابعة الملاحظات. مراجعة جودة المخرجات، والتحقق من وضوح النصوص والأرقام، وصحة ترتيب الصفحات، وجودة الصور، واتساق التنسيق. تسليم النسخ النهائية بصيغ مناسبة للعرض والطباعة والنشر، مع حفظ الوقت والالتزام بالمواعيد النهائية. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والدقة في العمل. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة مكة المكرمة، وتتطلب التعاون الوثيق مع فرق المشروع المختلفة لضمان تسليم مخرجات تصميم Contribute to the development of standard templates, playbooks, dashboards, automation initiatives, and lessons learned. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of solid regulatory affairs experience. Demonstrated quality-focused mindset. Ability to work effectively in agile, matrixed, and multicultural environments. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. AstraZeneca in Saudi Arabia is undergoing a transformation focused on advancing healthcare and innovation, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030.
